decision: Test what the tool actually replaces before making a savings claim.
evidence: N1 is USD 600/month cash spend; N2 adds 6 × USD 60 = USD 360/month imputed staff time.
Combined economic burden is USD 960/month. A USD 500 tool does not yet prove either burden disappears.
next_actions: Measure residual coordination and confirm whether the outside provider can be canceled.
caveats: USD 460 is a conditional economic difference only, not verified cash savings.
